literal: Even when [someone] does harmful things out of anger, not doing harmful things in return is the principle of those who are free from blemish.
translation: Even when others do harm out of anger, refraining from doing harm in return is the principle of those who are free from blemish.
modern: ஒருவர் கோபம்கொண்டு துன்பம் செய்தபோதிலும், அவருக்குத் திரும்பத் துன்பம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே குற்றமற்றவர்களின் கொள்கையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core standard of conduct for those who are pure and free from moral blemish (மாசற்றார்). The word 'கறுத்து' literally means 'having darkened' with rage, describing a person who acts out of blind anger to cause pain (இன்னா). Even under such extreme provocation (அக்கண்ணும்), a person of pure character must not retaliate with harm in return (மறுத்து இன்னா செய்யாமை). This steadfast refusal to return evil for evil is declared to be their defining principle (கோள்).
